components.name: FormLabel
components.note: FormLabel is a @deprecated alias of Label; guidelines import Label. File stays form-label.md to match the module and docs slug.

components.name: Media
components.note: No Media export; module ships Image and Video.

tokens.note: Eluan tokens carry no namespace prefix. names lists every custom property defined in packages/tokens/src/*.css. Components should read the semantic layer (themes.css, spacing.css, curves.css, typeset.css), not primitives.

themeGenerator.note: Generates colour only. Spacing density and curves are EluanProvider axes (data-spacing, data-curves), not generator output.

docsSite.note: Separate repo. Per-component docs paths are relative to it.

missingComponents.Alert: No Alert export. Form-level and page-level messages use Banner (position inline | top | bottom); field errors use FormMessage. Affects t05.
missingComponents.EmptyState: No component. patterns/empty-states.md composes Typography + Button, per 'When nothing fits'. Affects t07.
missingComponents.Link: No Link export. Button variant="link" (asChild for <a>) or the framework's link. Breadcrumb/Pagination/NavigationMenu have their own link parts.
missingComponents.IconButton: No export. Icon-only actions are Button size icon | iconSm | iconXs | iconInline. Affects t13.
missingComponents.List: No List component. Router template row 'list for scanning' needs rewording or removal.

foundations.elevation: No shadow/elevation tokens. Card elevation (none|sm|md|...) and ~20 overlay components hardcode boxShadow literals. Proposal: drop foundations/elevation.md and note it in the router (use Card elevation / overlay components; never write box-shadow).
foundations.motion: No duration/easing tokens; 42 component files set transition/animation literals. Convention is reduced-motion gating. Proposal: keep foundations/motion.md as rules only (no token table).
foundations.focus: No dedicated focus-ring token; components outline with --interactive-border. Paper audit measured ~1.26:1 light / 1.31:1 dark (below WCAG 3:1). Guidelines must not claim focus contrast is handled.
foundations.iconSize: No icon-specific tokens; icons size from --size-* (density-aware).

gaps.theming: Theme generator controls colour only (1-3 accents, neutral tint, min contrast). Curves, spacing density and typeset are EluanProvider axes. PLAN.md's theming.md brief says the generator controls 'colour, curves, spacing'; theming.md will describe the real split.
gaps.toast: toast() is not re-exported from @eluan/core. Toast is the Sonner <Toaster> mount; consumers import toast from 'sonner' and need it as a direct dependency under pnpm.
gaps.docs: Docs site is a separate repo (vasfio/eluan-docs), so eluan CI can't read it. 11 docs pages have no PropsTable: breadcrumb command dropdown-menu fieldset menubar navigation-drawer pagination scroll-area skeleton table toast. Phase 3 API generator should read component types, not docs tables.
gaps.naming: DateTimePicker kebabs to date-time-picker.md (module and docs slug are datetime-picker). media.tsx has no Media export (Image, Video); proposed file media.md with name Media. FormLabel is a deprecated alias of Label; form-label.md documents Label.
gaps.knownSourceIssues: Paper audit found unfixed component bugs (progress tone fills, checked+disabled checkbox/radio, navigation-menu active state, pagination undefined --interactive-fg-hover, command shortcut on highlight, etc.). Guidelines will route around them with REVIEW markers rather than document them as intended. See .claude/design-system-fix-plan.md in the main checkout.
gaps.shipping: Resolved in Phase 3: scripts/skills/pack.mjs copies skills/eluan into packages/core/skills at prepack; files includes skills.
gaps.existingSkills: .claude/skills/eluan/SKILL.md (name: eluan, 513 lines, consumer + contributor) overlaps the new router's name and scope. Left untouched; decide later whether the router supersedes it. skills/eluan-* are contributor/setup skills and don't overlap.
